Start date: 1383-08-04 (assuming format DD-MM-YYYY, so August 4, 1383).  

Add 140 days:

140 − 27 = 113 days left.  
September 1383 has 30 days → 113 − 30 = 83 left.  
October has 31 days → 83 − 31 = 52 left.  
November has 30 days → 52 − 30 = 22 left.  
December has 31 days → 22 days into December = December 22, 1383.
